identity.title: Audit governance regression policy against real dogfood cases

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Review the existing regression ordering policy only against the real/golden cases established through 8067 and 8072. In particular, verify ambiguous orderings such as validation not_run versus failed and outcome review_required versus blocked/failed. Do not change rankings unless a real case proves the current ordering yields a factually wrong governance delta.
human_pressure.why_now: Regression ranks encode governance policy, not raw facts. They need evidence-backed review before being treated as stable semantics.

machine_core.goal: Produce an evidence-backed audit of existing regression transition ordering and make only the smallest correction if a real accepted case demonstrates a wrong transition.
invariants: Current rank tables remain unchanged unless contradicted by a documented real case.
UNKNOWN and INCOMPARABLE remain non-ordered states.
Policy changes require before/after case evidence and focused tests.

steps.title: Inventory current rank semantics
details: Document each existing ordered dimension and non-ordered transition rule from code.

steps.title: Check against accepted real cases
details: Use only 8067/8072 accepted cases and existing producer-neutral tests.
Flag ambiguous but unproven questions as open policy questions, not defects.

steps.title: Apply minimal correction only if proven
details: If and only if a real case proves a wrong transition, change the smallest ranking and add a focused regression test.

acceptance: Every existing rank policy is documented and classified as supported, untested/ambiguous, or contradicted by real evidence.
Any code change has a real-case regression test.

producer.artifact: evidence-backed audit of existing regression transition ordering

observable_effect.assertion: Every rank policy is documented and classified; only accepted real-case evidence drives corrections.

proofs.assertion: Audit documents all rank policies; any code change has a real-case backing and full tests pass.

must_check: Evidence basis is limited to accepted real/golden cases and current code.
Ambiguity is not converted into an invented ranking.
Any changed rank has explicit before/after proof.
reject_if: Ranks are redesigned from intuition alone.
A numeric score or release gate is added.
Tests are rewritten to follow implementation without independent expected evidence.
